title: Pairwise Ranker I: Loss and Gradient
hints: Each pair affects the loss only through one number, its margin. Work out how one pair's cost changes with its margin, then how the margin changes with w.
Use the chain rule through the margin, and vectorize: stack the difference vectors into a matrix so every margin comes from a single matrix-vector product.
A pair pulls on w hardest when it is badly mis-ranked, and barely at all once it is ranked confidently. Rewrite log(1 + e^z) so you never exponentiate a large positive number.
